name: Tongyi DeepResearch 30B-A3B

lineage.how_derived: agentic continual pre-training plus SFT plus on-policy RL (custom GRPO); base confirmed by a model-card discussion reply from the authors

purpose: Agentic LLM for long-horizon, deep information-seeking tasks (web research with many search and page-visit steps), built by Alibaba's Tongyi Lab as an open-source AI researcher.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card says apache-2.0 and the HF repo has no LICENSE file; the inference repo Alibaba-NLP/DeepResearch LICENSE was read (Apache License 2.0, first lines, summarizer) and the base Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 is also Apache-2.0.

architecture.why_this_design: Blog: the IterResearch inference mode rebuilds a streamlined workspace around a central report each round to avoid 'cognitive suffocation' and 'noise pollution' from one ever-growing context; training uses fully synthetic agentic data because it is more consistent in distribution than human-annotated data such as BrowseComp, scales more easily and avoids commercial tool API calls. The MoE size (30B total, 3B active) is not justified in the text read.

other: community GGUFs (bartowski, mradermacher, Mungert and others)
engine_support.notes: Tool requirements of the vendor harness (Alibaba-NLP/DeepResearch, README read through a summarizer): web search and Google Scholar through Serper.dev (SERPER_KEY_ID); page reading through Jina.ai (JINA_API_KEYS) plus an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint for page summarization (API_KEY, API_BASE); a Python interpreter through SandboxFusion endpoints (SANDBOX_FUSION_ENDPOINT); a file parser through Dashscope (DASHSCOPE_API_KEY). Two modes: ReAct and the IterResearch 'Heavy' mode. All tools are paid or hosted services; a fully local setup needs replacements for search, visit and the sandbox. Qwen3-MoE architecture, so an engine with qwen3_moe support runs the weights.

strengths: Reference model for open deep-research work; two inference modes: ReAct and an IterResearch-based Heavy mode
weaknesses: Scores only as images on the card (numbers taken from the vendor blog)
Needs Serper, Jina, a summarizer LLM and a code sandbox: no fully local path out of the box
Superseded on BrowseComp by its own finetune SearchSwarm (68.1 self-reported vs 43.4) and by OpenResearcher on BrowseComp-Plus
soft.maturity: Alibaba Tongyi Lab; inference code in Alibaba-NLP/DeepResearch.
soft.behavior: Runs a ReAct tool loop (think, call search or visit, observe) over a 128K context; a reported failure is degenerate repeated tokens late in long BrowseComp runs, which the authors call a normal probabilistic failure of long generations.

user_reports.summary: Repeated-token degeneration on a BrowseComp question served with vLLM (TP 4, hermes tool parser, 128K); an author-side reply says all LLMs can fall into repetition with some probability.

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0 (text read), well-known baseline with many community GGUFs, 128K context, fits 16 GB-class machines; quality is below the newer SearchSwarm and OpenResearcher on their own tables. The harness (five tool backends) is the real work, not a license or quality problem. Missing qwen3_moe module is only a blocker.
blockers: agent harness with search, visit, python and file-parser tools

sources.note: inference repo README, summarizer read: tools, keys, 128K context
